title: Unlock English Fluency
hook: My five-day fluency sprint. Speak spontaneously and share your opinions with confidence.
metaTitle: Unlock English Fluency | 5-Day Online English Intensive
metaDescription: A five-day online English fluency sprint with Dr Christina Grey: 30 hours of live speaking practice in a small group of 6 to 12 (B2+). £300, including a 45-minute 1-to-1 consultation.
whoFor: Upper-intermediate and advanced learners who understand a lot of English but freeze, translate in their heads, or hold back when it's time to speak. Ideal if you want a big step forward in a single week.
practise: Speaking spontaneously on a new theme each day, such as culture, AI, work-life balance, or money
Linking your ideas with "bridges": ready-made phrases for agreeing, disagreeing, and buying time to think
Listening to real TED talks and podcasts, then explaining the key points to your group
Role-plays for real situations, using a simple way to acknowledge, respond, and close a conversation
Small talk, debating, and giving your opinion with confidence

session.text: A quick review of yesterday, warm-up questions, and the theme of the day with its key vocabulary.
Role-plays and discussions in small breakout rooms.
A proper break to recharge.
Listening to a TED talk or podcast in two groups, then sharing what you heard and debating it.
Real-life scenarios, reflection, and a short writing task.

included: A 45-minute 1-to-1 video consultation with me after the course
Daily handouts with vocabulary and phrases

testimonial.text: The week with you was totally different! I felt much more confident speaking English after just a few days. I was really surprised how comfortable I was speaking English by day 5.
testimonial.name: Hannah
